name: basketiq
description: BasketIQ — frontend + backend, deployed together as one web service

scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund --prefix backend && npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run db:push --prefix backend -- --skip-generate && npm run db:seed:prod --prefix backend
